description:
Cast Spark Double by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Spark Double leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Suspension Field returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Suspension Field enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Spark Double until Suspension Field leaves the battlefield.
When Spark Double leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Suspension Field until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Suspension Field leaves the battlefield, Spark Double returns to the battlefield from exile as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.
